entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. It's this VeloBand Pulse I bought a little while ago, and it's just not working out for me.
Okay, I understand. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's… ugh… it's under 'john.doe@email.com'. And hurry it up, I don't have all day.
Thank you, Mr. Doe. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse you purchased. What seems to be the issue?
The heart rate monitor is completely off! It's telling me I'm at 60 bpm when I'm practically dying on the treadmill. It's useless! I want to return it.

I understand your frustration, Mr. Doe. I'm sorry you're having issues with the VeloBand Pulse. Let me check our return policy for you. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the date of purchase.
90 days? Really? I thought I was past the deadline. I bought this thing like, two weeks ago, maybe a little over that. I was worried you'd say it was too late!

Not a problem at all, Mr. Doe! You're well within the 90 days. To process your return, I'll need to generate a return shipping label for you. I'll send it to your email address on file. Just box up the VeloBand Pulse, including all original packaging, and affix the label. You can then drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
So, I can just send back the whole smart watch and all the stuff that came with it?

Yes, Mr. Doe, please send back the entire VeloBand Pulse package. Once we receive it and confirm its condition, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account.
Alright, that sounds good. And just to be clear, there's no restocking fee or anything like that?

No restocking fee, Mr. Doe. A full refund will be issued. If you have any issues with the return label or the refund process, feel free to call us back, and ask for any agent. If it requires a deeper look, you may also speak to a manager.
Perfect! Thank you so much! I appreciate the help.
You're very welcome, Mr. Doe! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Have a great day, Mr. Doe! Thank you for choosing VeloFit.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Goodbye.
